scripts.clean:reports: npx rimraf allure-results allure-report test-results playwright-report
scripts.test: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test
scripts.test:headed: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:ui: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=ui-tests
scripts.test:ui:headed: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=ui-tests --headed
scripts.test:api: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=api-tests
scripts.test:e2e: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=e2e-tests
scripts.test:e2e:headed: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=e2e-tests --headed
scripts.test:smoke:chrome: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=ui-tests --headed -g smoke
scripts.test:regression:chrome: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --project=ui-tests --headed -g regression
scripts.test:debug: npm run clean:reports && npx playwright test --headed --debug
